authority: Static representation policy only; manpower, formation, ownership and appointment truth remain in native owners.

automatic_person_lite.rule: Inside these scopes, ordinary 1,000/500 commanders become person-lite; 100-man and below remain aggregate unless independently salient.

external_command_rule: Army commander/deputy and persistent unit commander/deputy are outside fighting-strength troop numbers.
loadout_rule: Army/unit commander and deputy use loadout_house_champion. Internal infantry commanders use loadout_house_guard; internal cavalry commanders use loadout_house_champion. Wei-assigned Qin uses the same troop-type rule without changing Qin ownership.
materialization_rule: Every internal person-lite consumes one conserved fighting body. Representation never creates manpower.
